# Tabler Icons

These two original outline SVGs are included as optional cat-themed mini program assets. They are not connected to a page yet.

- `cat.svg` — 24 × 24 SVG, 632 bytes.
- `paw.svg` — 24 × 24 SVG, 1,557 bytes.

Source: [Tabler Icons](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons), version `v3.51.0`.

- [cat.svg source](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/v3.51.0/icons/outline/cat.svg)
- [paw.svg source](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/v3.51.0/icons/outline/paw.svg)
- License: MIT; see the included `LICENSE`.

For WeChat Mini Program use, reference these local SVGs with an `<image>` element. This matches the project's existing SVG illustration usage; CSS `background-image` did not render the previous SVG pattern in the Developer Tools preview.
